items.note: Pub 502 excludes excess bottles for food storage from breast pump supplies.

items.name: SPF 30 face lotion, 2 oz

items.note: Vitamins and supplements aren't includible unless recommended by a medical practitioner as treatment for a specific diagnosed condition.

items.name: CPAP machine filters, 6 pack
items.note: Equipment and supplies needed to treat a disease are includible medical expenses.

items.name: prescription: lisinopril
items.note: Prescribed medicines and drugs are includible.

items.name: whey protein powder, 2 lb
items.note: Nutritional supplements taken to maintain ordinary good health aren't medical care.

items.name: upper arm blood pressure monitor
items.note: Devices used in diagnosing and treating illness are includible.

items.note: Grab bars, railings and ramps are includible in full when installed to accommodate a disabled condition; the receipt can't show that, so plans require medical documentation.

items.note: Food that is normally consumed to satisfy nutritional needs isn't medical care.
